description: RDP-level trigger fixtures. Schema is compatible with the per-skill evals/triggers.json convention ({q, trigger, note}) plus two additive fields: `discipline` (which RDP component should/shouldn't engage) and `host` (the host's agent-self-assessed reasoning strength: `standard` or `strong` — table-free, per ADR-035; NOT the skill's `model_tier`). `trigger:true` = the discipline SHOULD engage; `false` = it should stay gated off (no gap, strong-reasoning host, or trivial task). Per-skill triggers.json files are seeded from these rows when each skill lands (Phases 4-6). Live scoring uses src/scripts/skill_trigger_eval.py (model calls, Phase 7); validate_fixtures.py checks shape cost-free now.
